reviewer: coordinating assistant; not independent native-speaker assessment
scope: Read all 38 inputs and four generated outputs after generation; compare concrete differences, not merely execution success.

criteria.meaning: Preserve propositions, negation, participants, tense, quotation and speech acts.
criteria.politeness: Preserve addressee level and subject honorification; lexical dialectness cannot compensate for lowering respect.
criteria.dialect_form: Identify contextual dialect changes; unchanged input is not automatically an error, and more changes are not automatically better.
criteria.naturalness: Flag obvious malformed or mixed forms; do not claim native-speaker-certified naturalness.

quality_claim_limit: One development run; no gold dialect reference and no statistical/generalization claim.
